reference_sql:
WITH campaign_spend AS (  -- one row per campaign with spend in 2025
  SELECT ch.channel_name, c.campaign_id, SUM(a.spend) AS spend
  FROM ad_spend_daily a
  JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
  JOIN channels ch ON ch.channel_id = c.channel_id
  WHERE a.spend_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND a.spend_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY ch.channel_name, c.campaign_id
),
ranked AS (  -- one row per campaign with spend in 2025
  SELECT channel_name, campaign_id, spend,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY channel_name ORDER BY spend DESC, campaign_id) AS rn
  FROM campaign_spend
)
SELECT channel_name, campaign_id, spend
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
alternatives:
WITH campaign_spend AS (  -- one row per campaign with spend in 2025
  SELECT ch.channel_name, c.campaign_id, SUM(a.spend) AS spend
  FROM ad_spend_daily a
  JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
  JOIN channels ch ON ch.channel_id = c.channel_id
  WHERE a.spend_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND a.spend_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY ch.channel_name, c.campaign_id
)
SELECT cs.channel_name, cs.campaign_id, cs.spend
FROM campaign_spend cs
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM campaign_spend cs2
                  WHERE cs2.channel_name = cs.channel_name
                    AND (cs2.spend > cs.spend OR (cs2.spend = cs.spend AND cs2.campaign_id < cs.campaign_id)))

SELECT t.channel_name, t.campaign_id, t.spend
FROM (
  -- one row per campaign with spend in 2025
  SELECT ch.channel_name, c.campaign_id, SUM(a.spend) AS spend,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ch.channel_name ORDER BY SUM(a.spend) DESC, c.campaign_id) AS rn
  FROM ad_spend_daily a
  JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
  JOIN channels ch ON ch.channel_id = c.channel_id
  WHERE a.spend_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND a.spend_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY ch.channel_name, c.campaign_id
) AS t
WHERE t.rn = 1
